# Thread sanitizer suppressions for .github/workflows/sanitizers.yml. Each entry says why the report is not a bug in Vauta.
#
# An actor whose executor is a DispatchSerialQueue (`unownedExecutor`): the thread sanitizer does not see that two jobs of the same
# serial queue never overlap, so it reports the actor's own state, read in one job and written in the next, as a race. All of that
# state is actor-isolated, which the compiler checks. A twenty-line program shows it on its own: the same accesses race on such an
# actor and do not on a default actor (checked with Xcode 27's toolchain, November 2026). These two engines run their MLX work on a
# utility queue, never on the cooperative pool, and are the only actors with such an executor.
race:SearchModelEngine.swift
race:LanguageModelEngine.swift
